exitCodes.meaning: CLI-side failure — invalid path, malformed id, or a bad option combination.
Broker unreachable — agent not registered, or awaiting SMAppService approval.
Broker answered but no app endpoint was registered, and the app could not be started.
Delivered to the app, which replied with a failure.
The app terminated while the request was in flight.
The app is running but not registered with the broker, and did not re-register within the poll bound.
Could not determine, deterministically, which on-disk app bundle to target.
Reached the app, but the Project's startup commands need approval and the prompt in Batty went unanswered. Nothing was opened.

--path is not valid with --view <kind> (only git-status accepts --path)

command.description: Run this command in the new pane in place of the default shell; with --wait it is typed into the shell instead.

json.description: Emit JSON (paneID, created, tabID, and with --wait exitCode, durationMs, waitResult) instead of the id.

timeout.description: Seconds --wait waits, at most 86400. Defaults to 600. The command keeps running after a timeout.

unique.description: With --view <kind>, print the id of an existing visible pane of that kind instead of creating one. viewOptions differences (--path/--pid) do not defeat the match. Requires a non-terminal --view.

view.description: Pane content kind for the new pane. Defaults to terminal.

wait.description: Type the command into a shell and wait for it to finish, then report its exit status. Needs bash or zsh. Blocks up to --timeout; MCP callers should pass a timeout below their client's tool-call limit.
